items.title: Wendy Oxenhorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 22, 2026
items.q: Oh, my boyfriend – I love him.

ctx.x: It’s funny you should put it that way but there was really not much recourse. There were contracts they signed with labels, record companies, for their own publishing that they could never get. I remember a musician telling me a very famous label, when he said that he wanted his own publishing the executive said to him, “No,” – and I’m not going to use the N word – but he said, “No N is going to ever have his own publishing while I’m alive.” You know? This is how it was when you recorded with someone like Frank…

I used to be quite naïve about my musical heroes and jazz musicians in general thinking that because I saw their names on LPs and in concerts for a long time I assumed that they © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
